title: Credit for knowledge taught earlier
statement: How a knowledge-building course should give credit for what earlier lessons taught is not settled, when a text-dependence gate removes every question that prior knowledge can answer.
example: A gate-report template lists domain-knowledge items at about zero, by design.
detail: A review faulted a course that by design kept assessment passages from ever overlapping taught topics, so taught knowledge could never help (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/feedback_clean.md`). A certification template accepts domain-knowledge items at about zero, since recall items are passage-independent and the anti-leak filter removes them (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-merged-course/VERDICT_TEMPLATE.md`). The review asked for taught knowledge to recur in the learning texts with cold passages kept for the test, and the approved plan fades topic coherence gradually as the last scaffold (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/approval_clean.md`), which settles only part of it.

evidence.quote: by design ensures assessment passages never overlap taught topics
Sequence the learning texts so taught knowledge recurs and compounds, and reserve cold, non-overlapping passages for the test only, where that property belongs.
2. **KCT1 Domain-knowledge ≈ 0 — by design.** Domain-recall items are passage-independent → removed
is the last scaffold, and like every other scaffold it fades gradually

The G4 red team proved the trap empirically: **6/6 sampled EBSR items were blind-solvable, including Magellan/explorer items answerable from prior knowledge.** Knowledge-rich topics make this *worse*, the better we teach world knowledge, the more items become answerable without the passage unless disjointness is designed in.
the better we teach world knowledge, the more items become blind-solvable unless designed against.
HIGH blind-solve risk (castles/knights saturate children's media).
Items anchor to this text's particulars; canon facts banned as answer keys; cross-family blind-solve gate mandatory.
**KCT1 Domain-knowledge = 0 — by design, not omission.** Domain-knowledge *recall* items are inherently passage-independent, so the anti-leak filter removes them.
